title: Police-involved shooting in Burnaby leaves man dead, prompts independent probe
subtitle: One man is dead after a police-involved shooting early this morning, the Independent Investigation Office has confirmed.
article: One man is dead after a police-involved shooting early Thursday morning in Burnaby, the Independent Investigation Office has confirmed.
Spokesman Owen Court says officers responded to a 911 call about a man with a knife in the 4100-block of Albert Street.
An RCMP officer saw a man that matched the description provided by the 911 caller at Hastings St. and MacDonald Ave.

The man, whose name has not been released, was shot and transported to hospital where he later died. Court said the coroner will release his name once the family has been notified, but added that no details about the man\'s history would be released.
Neighbours report hearing two or three shots after police were confronted by a man with a knife.
The Independent Investigations Office, which probes police incidents involving death or serious harm, has assigned seven members to the case.
There\'s no word what may have prompted the altercation.
Several blocks of Hastings Street were closed to traffic Thursday morning as police processed the scene.
